            No machine connected
            What’s detected?

            Codex, Claude Code, Coven, Gemini CLI, Aider and OpenCode processes owned by your local user. CPU, memory, uptime and OS process state update every 5 seconds. Sleeping means the process is not using CPU at that instant; it may still be working. Agent activity is separate from OS state; unavailable activity integrations show Unknown. Remote machines and unrecognized agents are not scanned. Prompts and command arguments stay off this dashboard.

            SCREEN-SHARE PRIVACY

            Keep your space private.

            Checking desktop connection…

            1. Start a share window. Allow Screen Recording if macOS asks.
            2. In Google Meet, choose Present now → A window, then Open Sesame — Protected Share.
            3. Check Meet’s preview before presenting. Keep the share window open.
            The widget stays visible to you and is excluded from this share window. Sharing your entire screen can still show Open Sesame.

            No recording is saved and no audio is captured. Open Sesame does not send the video; Meet shares the window you select.

            Use the installed Mac app to create a share window that excludes Open Sesame. In this browser, share a separate app window or tab.

            Someone physically looking at your monitor can still see the widget.

            Open Sesame is floating

            Keep this tab open while you work.

            A FEW THINGS TO TRY

            Small widget. Real interactions.

            Explore the feel of a menu bar companion without leaving your browser.

            1. Find its shape. Switch placement, then use width and ratio to tune the compact notch. Expanded panels keep enough room for controls.
            2. Open it up. Click the notch or menu bar eyes. Try hover expansion, or use E to toggle and Esc to collapse.
            3. Choose a tab. Use the icons on the left of the expanded widget. Hover for a view name, or use Up and Down while the rail is focused. Open Focus for music services, timed focus topics, YouTube, or your own audio/video files; capture an item, or open Reader for RSS and your reading list. Use the folder in the top bar to choose a project. In Projects, open a category and select an item for details. Type /task to add a to-do; pasted links become bookmarks.
            4. Check the fit. Change desktop resolution. Inspect zooms the widget to native CSS size; Present gives the desktop more room.
            This is a browser simulation. Music playback uses Spotify, Apple Music, or YouTube embeds. YouTube and media playback use real player controls; notifications stay inside the preview. Your notes and settings are stored on this device. Live audio uses browser permissions; transcription may use your browser’s online speech service. Option + Shift + P explains screen-share privacy. This web preview cannot hide itself from a full-screen share.
